decisive_items: visual evoked potentials were normal, and electroretinography indicated no pathologic process

response.rationale: All objective tests (VEP, ERG, imaging, pupillary and fundus exams) are normal, ruling out organic optic neuropathy or brain injury; the clinical picture fits functional visual loss, hence conversion disorder.

rejected.why: Concussion alone does not explain bilateral complete vision loss with normal brain imaging and no neurologic deficits.
Traumatic optic neuropathy would show abnormal VEP/ERG or pupillary defect; bilateral symmetric involvement with all tests normal is inconsistent.
